Universal Aventura Hotel

Experience a fresh, fun way to stay. A perfectly priced, affordable escape that fits your style and budget. Aventura stylish design adds a special current of energy to every visit. Plus, you’ll get the exclusive theme park benefits that come with being a Universal Orlando hotel guest.


Stay centre stage at Hard Rock Hotel® Orlando!

Just a short distance from Universal Orlando's theme parks, you can live like a star and get treated like a celebrity with impeccable surroundings, laid-back attitude and show-stopping service. With a palm-lined swimming pool featuring underwater music, incredible music memorabilia, and amped-up recreation featuring live music, you'll enjoy exclusive theme park benefits such as Early Park Admission(1) to enter the theme parks up to an hour early, and Universal Express Unlimited(2) to enjoy shorter wait times on select rides and attractions. (Valid at Universal Studios Florida and Universal Islands of Adventure. Theme park admission required. Valid at select attractions.)
